coinflip.html.bandLabel: approx. 95% range at each bet for a fair coin (Model A)
coinflip.html.bandCaption: The grey band is an approximate 95% range at each bet taken on its own: after bet i, a fair coin's Model A total lands within ±1.96·√i dollars about 95% of the time (normal approximation). It is not a promise that 95% of whole random runs stay inside the band from start to finish — over many bets, more than 5% of fair runs poke out somewhere. The coin's Model A line is inside that range at every one of its bets.
